# Bentley Motors

> > Bentley Motors: Official global site for handcrafted luxury performance vehicles including Continental GT, Flying Spur, and Bentayga SUV models with Beyond100 electrification strategy.

Bentley Motors manufactures ultra-luxury automobiles from its carbon-neutral factory in Crewe, England. The site showcases the complete model range, Mulliner bespoke customization services, sustainability initiatives through the Beyond100 strategy and Environmental Foundation, and regional content for key markets including China and India.

## Key Topics

- Continental GT
- Flying Spur
- Bentayga
- Beyond100 Strategy
- Mulliner Customization
- Electrification & Plug-in Hybrid
- Handcrafted Luxury
- Carbon Neutrality
- Bentley Environmental Foundation
- W.O. Bentley Heritage
- Grand Tourer Performance
- Luxury SUV
- Factory Tours
- Chinese Market (添越/欧陆GT/宾利飞驰)
- Car Configurator

- [Bentley models: the world's widest range of handcrafted cars](https://www.bentleymotors.com/cn/zh/models.html): Complete Bentley lineup: Bentayga EWB, Flying Spur, Continental GT models

- [宾利](https://www.bentleymotors.com/cn/zh.html): Bentley China homepage featuring luxury SUVs, sedans and GT models

## Beyond100 Sustainability & Electrification

- [Bentley Hybrid Technology | Sustainability |Bentley Motors](https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/about-bentley/beyond-100.html): Beyond100 strategy: hybrid powertrains & carbon-neutral Crewe factory
- [百年荣耀 | 关于宾利 | 宾利汽车](https://www.bentleymotors.com/cn/zh/about-bentley/beyond-100.html): Beyond100 strategy: electrification & carbon-neutral commitment in China
- [Bentley Electrification | Hybrid Technology | Bentley Motors](https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/about-bentley/beyond-100/coming-this-way.html): Bentley's electrification roadmap with plug-in hybrid & urban SUV plans
- [Bentley Electrification | Bentley Motors](https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/about-bentley/beyond-100/bentley-brand-manifesto.html): Bentley brand manifesto: fusion of performance & luxury with PHEV tech
- [Bentley Environmental Foundation | Projects | Bentley Motors](https://www.bentleymotors.com/en/about-bentley/beyond-100/bentley-foundation.html): Bentley Foundation's environmental sustainability & philanthropic initiatives
